task.title: Request a generation set from an issue
task.shortdesc: Open a issue in . drafts the set and opens one draft pull request per topic, usually in under .

prereq.p: The launch facts file for the generation is in the repository's facts folder. See .

step.cmd: In Launch facts file, enter the path, for example facts/tpu7x.yaml.

info.p: The alignr workflow starts. It drafts the set, builds it with DITA-OT in strict mode with the drafts in place, and opens the pull requests.

step.cmd: Wait for the comment on the issue.

info.p: It lists each topic, its pull request and its open questions, and the time from the issue to the last pull request.

result.p: Each pull request is a draft, labeled alignr:draft, with the topic's report as its description and five statuses. See .
